properties.name: British India, 1930 (including Burma)
properties.includes: the provinces and the princely states, Burma, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
properties.excludes: Sikkim, Nepal and Bhutan; the French and Portuguese settlements
properties.source: British India: hand-traced for this map as it stood in 1931. Burma: a modern outline cut to meet that tracing. The Andaman and Nicobar Islands: Natural Earth 1:10m.
properties.note: India and Burma share their frontier vertex for vertex and are dissolved into one outline along it.
